name: Number Two Presses the Button
description: Number Two stands in the dim light, watching the scene unfold. He reaches out and presses a button on the control panel. A soft click echoes, and a series of lights flicker to life, indicating the system is now active.
related_events: Number Two presses a button

name: Mrs. Kensington Arrives at the Nightclub
description: A Jaguar pulls up in front of the nightclub. Mrs. Kensington opens the door and steps out, wearing a tight leather fightsuit. She stands by the car as the club's lights flicker overhead, the sound of music pulsing from within.
related_events: Mrs. Kensington exits Jaguar in front of nightclub

name: People React to the Rocket Outside the Club
description: A group of individuals standing outside the club looked up as a rocket appeared in the sky. Their attention shifted suddenly toward it, some pointing, others stepping back in surprise. The glow illuminated their faces, and murmurs spread through the crowd as they watched the rocket ascend.
related_events: People react to the rocket outside the club

name: Jaguar Arrives at the Front Door
description: A Jaguar adorned with the Union Jack pulls up and stops in front of the house. The car comes to a halt at the front door.
related_events: Jaguar arrives at the front door

name: Austin Hides in a Phone Booth and Escapes with a Disguise
description: Austin steps into a phone booth and turns his back as the mob runs past. Once they pass, he steps out, now wearing a beard, and walks away.
related_events: Austin hides in phone booth while mob runs by
Austin steps out of phone booth in disguise

name: Bob's Big Boy Rocket Lifts Off
description: The Bob's Big Boy rocket rises into the air, leaving the ground behind as it begins its flight.
related_events: Bob's Big Boy rocket lifts off

name: Austin Forces Information from Patty O'Brien
description: Austin demands to know who Number Two works for. Patty O'Brien remains silent, then quietly tells him to go to hell. In response, Austin grabs her head and forces it into the toilet bowl. He flushes, and the sound of water fills the room as muffled gurgling comes from Patty.
related_events: Austin flushes Patty O'Brien's head in a toilet

name: Austin Takes ID and Business Card from Patty's Wallet
description: Austin reaches into Patty O'Brien's wallet and removes his Dr. Evil ID card and Alotta's Virtucon business card, which has her address on it.
related_events: Austin retrieves items from Patty O'Brien's wallet

name: Texan Responds to Austin's Distress
description: The Texan sees Austin's feet thrashing wildly and hears him grunting. He calls out, telling Austin to relax and not force it, suggesting he try using creative visualization instead.
related_events: Texan observes Austin's feet moving frantically
Texan hears Austin grunting
Texan advises Austin to relax and use visualization

name: Patty O'Brien Attacks Austin with Garotte Wire
description: Austin sits down. Behind him, a panel slides open, revealing Patty O'Brien. His charm bracelet jingles. Austin looks back. Patty's bracelet is now garotte wire. She wraps it around his throat. Austin gets his thumbs between the wire and his neck, straining to keep it from cutting off his air.
related_events: Patty O'Brien emerges through sliding panel
Patty O'Brien attacks Austin with garotte wire
Austin defends himself from garotte attack

name: Austin Forces Patty O'Brien to the Toilet and Demands Answers
description: Austin breaks free from the charm bracelet garotte, grabs Patty O'Brien's head, and forces it toward the toilet bowl. With Patty's head hovering above the water, Austin demands to know who Number Two works for.
related_events: Austin breaks free from the charm bracelet garotte
Austin forces Patty O'Brien's head toward the toilet bowl
Austin demands to know who Number Two works for

name: Austin and Vanessa Navigate the Casino
description: Austin and Vanessa walk through the casino in Las Vegas. Austin greets people with two-handed handshakes, and the people stare at him as if he's strange. He says he loves Las Vegas but forgot his x-ray glasses. Vanessa offers him her x-ray glasses. Austin decides to use a cover name, saying it's important that the name be generic so they don't draw attention to themselves.
related_events: Austin greets people with two-handed handshakes at the casino
Austin decides to use a cover name in Las Vegas
Vanessa offers her x-ray glasses to Austin

name: Dr. Evil's Escape in the Bob's Big Boy Rocket
description: The Bob's Big Boy rocket lifts off and climbs through the sky, eventually breaking through into space as it leaves Earth's atmosphere. Inside, Mr. Bigglesworth is flattened against the window, his body pressed tightly by the force of the ascent. From within the rocket, Dr. Evil speaks with a shivering voice, vowing to return when free love has ended and greed once again dominates the world.
related_events: Bob's Big Boy rocket exits Earth's atmosphere
Mr. Bigglesworth is pressed against the window during launch
Dr. Evil delivers a vengeful farewell speech from the rocket

name: Austin Catches the Fake Blind Man and Attacks Him
description: Austin flips a coin toward a blind man's cup. The man, who can actually see, shifts the cup to catch the coin. Austin wags his finger at him, then knees him in the groin.
related_events: Austin flips coin into blind man's cup
Sighted man repositions cup to catch coin
Austin confronts fake blind man with finger wag
Austin knees fake blind man in the groin

name: Austin Makes a Guard Laugh with a Surprise Flower
description: Austin approaches a Buckingham Palace guard standing stiffly in his red coat and begins making faces and gestures to get him to laugh. The guard remains expressionless, staying at attention. Unfazed, Austin reaches behind the guard's head and pulls out a large, colorful 1960s-style flower. The guard's stern demeanor breaks, and he bursts into laughter. Austin joins in, and the two share a moment of genuine amusement.
related_events: Austin attempts to amuse Buckingham Palace guard with antics
Austin reveals flower behind guard's head
Guard and Austin share mutual laughter

name: Girls Discover Austin in Photo Booth with Models and the Queen
description: The girls run past a Sixties-era photo booth and notice someone inside. A film strip emerges showing Austin posing with a series of exotic models. In the final image, Austin is seen with the Queen. Moments later, Austin steps out of the booth.
related_events: Girls run past a Sixties-era photo booth with someone inside
Photo strip captures Austin with various exotic models
Photo strip reveals Austin with the Queen
Austin exits the photo booth

name: Austin Finds Patty O'Brien's Body and Charms Fall from Her Hand
description: Austin steps out of his stall and sees Patty O'Brien's body, head-first in the toilet. Her hand drops to the floor, and a cluster of charms tumbles out — a heart, a moon, a star, and a clover. A moment later, a blue diamond charm falls from her hand.
related_events: Austin discovers Patty O'Brien's body in the toilet
Patty O'Brien's hand falls to the floor releasing charms
Blue diamond charm falls from Patty O'Brien's hand

name: Team Prepares for Cryogenic Mission and Receives Briefing on Dr. Evil
description: Basil Exposition, Command Gilmour, and General Nicolai Borschvetsky put on heavy extreme-weather gear over their uniforms. Inside a secure facility, Exposition addresses the others, explaining that Dr. Evil had himself frozen in 1967 and that Austin Powers later volunteered to be frozen in case Dr. Evil ever returned. He states that they now believe Dr. Evil has begun another plot to take over the world. Command Gilmour steps forward and opens a large vault door, from which a thick cloud of cold mist pours out.
related_events: Basil Exposition, Command Gilmour, and General Borschvetsky don extreme-weather gear
Basil Exposition briefs Command Gilmour and General Borschvetsky on Dr. Evil's history
Command Gilmour opens a vault door releasing cold mist

name: Austin and the Texan Share Restroom Banter
description: Austin enters a restroom stall. A moment later, a gregarious man in a large cowboy hat enters the stall next to him. The Texan says, 'Good luck, buddy. You don't buy food, you rent it.' Austin replies, 'Too right, youth.'
related_events: Austin enters the restroom and occupies a stall
Texan enters the adjacent stall and exchanges words with Austin
Texan delivers philosophical remark about food and ownership
Austin responds with agreement and informal address

name: Austin Defends Himself with Judo Chops
description: Two bad guys attack Austin. He responds by delivering quick judo chops, striking each of them. The attackers fall back, and the immediate threat ends. A mob of girls then catches up to Austin, who turns and runs away.
related_events: Two bad guys attack Austin
Austin performs multiple judo chops on attackers

name: Austin Flees the Mob of Girls
description: The mob of girls catches up to Austin. He turns and runs, darting away as they close in behind him.
related_events: Mob of girls catches up to Austin
Austin flees from the mob of girls

name: Austin Teases a Pregnant Protester and Shares a Laugh
description: Austin spots a heavily pregnant hippy girl standing with a placard that reads 'PROTEST!' in a colorful, funky font. He smirks and says, 'You might want to protest a bit louder next time, luv.' She grins, and they both laugh together. The moment passes quickly, a brief exchange of humor between strangers.
related_events: Austin notices pregnant hippy girl holding protest sign
Austin teases hippy girl about volume of protest
Austin and hippy girl share a laugh

name: Austin Reveals His Passport
description: A full-screen image shows Austin's passport opening to his official photo, where he appears stern and serious. Suddenly, he flashes a wide, mischievous grin, revealing his crooked teeth. The page turns, revealing a series of visa stamps from countries around the world.
related_events: Austin's passport is displayed with photo and visa stamps

name: Austin Reacts to the Cat and Leaves for the Restroom
description: Vanessa asks why Austin is leaving so soon. Austin replies that he gets bad vibes from cat Number Two because it has an X-ray eyepatch. He says they should go back to the room, but first he needs to go to the naughty chair and see a man about a dog. Then he heads to the restroom.
related_events: Austin expresses discomfort about cat Number Two
Austin announces intention to visit the restroom

name: Austin Goes to the Restroom
description: Austin stands up and walks away from Vanessa, making his way toward the restroom. He moves steadily down the hall, reaches the door, and goes inside.
related_events: Austin heads to the restroom

name: Dr. Evil Eliminates Failing Associates
description: Dr. Evil sits at a large conference table with six evil associates, including a Latin American Revolutionary in a field jacket and turtleneck, twin Nordic doctors, and a meter maid. He announces that his plot to hijack nuclear weapons has failed. Without hesitation, he presses a button, causing the chairs of the Revolutionary, the twin doctors, and the meter maid to tip backward and drop into a pit below. The chairs return empty and smoking. Dr. Evil then addresses Mustafa, who wears a red fez, and Frau Farbissina, dressed in a severe Salvation Army uniform, stating that he has spared their lives. He declares his intention to go to London and set a trap for Austin Powers.
related_events: Dr. Evil announces failure of nuclear weapons hijack plot
Dr. Evil executes failing associates by dropping chairs into a pit

name: Dr. Evil Recruits Survivors for Trap in London
description: After the conference table tipped back, sending the Revolutionary, the twin Nordic doctors, and the meter maid falling into a pit, their chairs returning empty and smoking, Dr. Evil turned his attention to the two remaining figures. He addressed Mustafa, the man in the red fez, and Frau Farbissina, standing stiffly in her severe Salvation Army uniform. With his ringed hand stroking a white fluffy cat, Dr. Evil announced that Austin Powers was the only man who could stop him. He declared his plan to set a trap for Powers in London and ordered the two survivors to assist him.
related_events: Dr. Evil reveals plan to trap Austin Powers in London

name: Vanessa Shows Austin the Upgraded Jaguar
description: Vanessa and Austin drive through the city in the vintage Jaguar. As they ride, Vanessa points out the car's modern additions: a secure cellular phone, an on-board computer, and a Global Geosynchronous Positioning Device. She opens the glove compartment, which rotates to reveal a set of dental hygiene items—floss, toothpaste, toothbrush, dental mirror, and cleaning tool. Austin speculates that the items are disguised weapons or explosives, but Vanessa replies that there have been significant advances in dentistry. Austin looks puzzled and asks if there's something wrong with his teeth.
related_events: Vanessa and Austin drive together in a vintage Jaguar
Vanessa reveals technological upgrades in the Jaguar

name: Vanessa Reveals Dental Hygiene Display in Jaguar
description: The glove compartment in Austin's Jaguar rotates open, revealing a set of dental hygiene products—floss, toothpaste, toothbrush, dental mirror, and cleaning tool. Austin suggests the floss might be garotte wire, the toothpaste could contain plastic explosives, and the toothbrush might serve as a detonator. Vanessa responds that the items are exactly what they appear to be, explaining that recent advancements in dentistry made it practical to include them.
related_events: Glove compartment reveals hidden dental hygiene display
Austin speculates about hidden weapon functions in dental hygiene products
Vanessa explains recent advancements in dentistry

name: Receive Mission Briefing from Basil Exposition
description: Aboard a private jet at night, Vanessa's laptop emits a beep, displaying a new message. The screen shows Basil Exposition from British Intelligence. He addresses Austin and Vanessa, informing them of a company in Las Vegas called Virtucon that may be connected to Dr. Evil. He notes that many Virtucon executives frequent the hotel and casino where they will be staying, suggesting it as their first point of investigation. Before signing off, he adds a personal note, telling Austin to be careful. Vanessa closes the laptop as the pilot's voice comes over the loudspeaker, announcing the final descent into Las Vegas International Airport. The flight attendants begin collecting drinks, and Austin and Vanessa fasten the seatbelts on their bean bags.
related_events: Vanessa receives a computer notification during the flight
Basil Exposition contacts Austin and Vanessa via email
Basil Exposition warns Austin to be careful
Vanessa closes her laptop

name: Final Descent to Las Vegas
description: The pilot's voice comes over the loudspeaker, announcing the final descent into Las Vegas International Airport. Flight attendants move through the cabin, collecting drinks and preparing for landing. Austin and Vanessa fasten the seatbelts on their bean-bag seats as the plane begins its approach.
related_events: Pilot announces final descent into Las Vegas International Airport
Flight attendants prepare to collect drinks and secure cabin
Austin and Vanessa fasten their seatbelts

name: Austin Flees Schoolgirls Around the Corner
description: Austin sprints around a corner with a group of schoolgirls chasing close behind. They pursue him down the street, their footsteps quick and persistent. After a brief moment, the schoolgirls pick up his trail again and resume their chase.
related_events: Schoolgirls chase Austin around a corner
Schoolgirls resume pursuit of Austin

name: Austin Returns with a Baton and a Marching Band
description: Austin reappears from around the corner holding a baton, followed by a marching band. The band begins to play as the schoolgirls regroup and resume their pursuit. Austin breaks into a run, weaving through the crowd just as the band continues to advance in formation behind him.
related_events: Austin retrieves a baton and returns with a marching band

name: Austin Escapes in a Union Jack Jaguar
description: The schoolgirls continue their pursuit of Austin around the corner. He reappears moments later holding a baton, the marching band trailing behind him. The girls spot him again and resume the chase. A 1967 Jaguar XKE convertible, adorned with a large Union Jack, pulls up beside him. Austin leaps over the door into the moving car, and it speeds away, narrowly staying ahead of the crowd.
related_events: Jaguar convertible picks up Austin and speeds away
Austin leaps into a moving Jaguar convertible decorated with a Union Jack

name: Borschesky and Basil Exposition Discover Frozen Celebrities and an Empty Berth
description: Borschesky and Basil Exposition walk past a row of cryogenic holding berths, each containing a naked person in suspended animation. They see Gary Coleman, Evel Knievel wearing a cape, and Vanilla Ice, all frozen in place. Further along, they pass an empty berth with a label that reads "JOHN TRAVOLTA."
related_events: Group passes by cryogenic holding berths containing frozen celebrities
Discovery of empty cryogenic berth labeled for John Travolta

name: Austin Powers Thawed and Identified
description: They move through a row of cryogenic berths, each holding a naked person in suspended animation, including Gary Coleman, Evel Knievel with a cape, and Vanilla Ice. They pass an empty berth marked with a plate that reads 'John Travolta.' Finally, they find Austin Powers, naked and covering himself, his face twisted in discomfort from the cold, his glasses frosted over, his body visibly hairy. A female voice on the PA announces the start of the laser cutting phase, and lasers carve Austin out of the ice in a single block. The robotic arm lifts the cube and places it into a vat of warm, liquid goo. After the goo phase, Austin stirs to life on a draining platform. As the reanimation completes, Basil Exposition turns to Borschovsky and says, 'No, he worked freelance—an internationally renowned swinging photographer by day and the ultimate gentleman spy by night.'
related_events: Austin Powers is found in cryogenic suspension
Basil Exposition explains Austin Powers' dual identity

name: Revival of Austin Powers
description: Lasers cut Austin Powers free from the ice, removing him in a single block. A robotic arm lifted the cube and placed it into a vat of warm liquid goo. The ice melted, and Austin emerged, coming back to life on a draining platform. The cleansing phase began as soon as he reanimated.
related_events: Lasers cut Austin Powers out of ice in a single cube
Robotic arm transfers ice cube to warm liquid goo vat
Austin Powers reanimates from goo on draining platform
Cleansing phase initiates after reanimation

name: Andy Warhol Meets Austin Powers and Receives a Can of Soup
description: Andy Warhol sits in front of his multi-colored Elvis painting and greets Austin Powers. Austin responds with a friendly hello and hands Andy a can of Campbell's Tomato Soup after Andy mentions he is hungry. Andy takes the can and says he will paint it and become famous without giving Austin any credit. Austin replies that if everyone can become famous, they'll each have their fifteen minutes of fame. Andy then says he will use that phrase and not give Austin credit for it either.
related_events: Andy Warhol greets Austin Powers
Austin Powers offers can of Campbell's soup to Andy Warhol

name: Andy Warhol Claims the Soup Can and the Quote
description: Andy Warhol takes a can of Campbell's Tomato Soup from Austin Powers and says he will paint it and become famous without giving Austin any credit. Moments later, when Austin remarks that everyone will have their fifteen minutes of fame, Andy repeats the phrase and declares he will use it without acknowledging Austin either.
related_events: Andy Warhol declares intention to paint soup can and gain fame
Andy Warhol claims credit for 'fifteen minutes of fame' quote

name: Andy Warhol's Soup Can Appears on Screen
description: A full-screen image of Andy Warhol's famous Soup Can painting fills the display, showing the red and white label with the Campbell's logo, centered and brightly lit against a plain background.
related_events: Andy Warhol's Soup Can painting appears on screen

name: Andy Warhol Paints Butterfly on Mod Girl's Thigh
description: Andy Warhol kneels beside a mod girl wearing a metallic miniskirt and carefully paints a butterfly on her thigh. The scene unfolds in front of his multi-colored Elvis painting, with the girl standing still as he applies the design.
related_events: Andy Warhol body paints butterfly on mod girl's thigh

name: Dr. Evil's Cryogenic Escape with Mr. Bigglesworth
description: Dr. Evil enters the room and climbs into an egg-shaped chair. A white mist fills the chair as the cryogenic freezing process begins. From within the mist, Dr. Evil's voice is heard declaring, 'Not this time. Come, Mr. Bigglesworth!' The white cat leaps into the chair just before the doors close. A sign on the egg reads 'CRYOGENIC FREEZING BEGINNING.'
related_events: Dr. Evil enters the room and climbs into an egg chair
Cryogenic freezing process begins in the egg chair
Dr. Evil speaks from within the mist and calls his cat
Dr. Evil's cat jumps into the egg chair before containment

name: Austin Confronts Dr. Evil and Fires at the Escaping Egg Chair
description: Austin enters the chamber and confronts Dr. Evil, who climbs into an egg-shaped chair. A white mist fills the chair as Dr. Evil's voice calls out from within, declaring his escape. He summons Mr. Bigglesworth, and a white cat leaps into the chair just before the doors close. A sign on the egg reads 'CRYOGENIC FREEZING BEGINNING.' Mrs. Kensington exclaims in shock, realizing Dr. Evil is freezing himself. Austin opens fire on the egg chair as the ceiling splits open. The egg rises upward, lifted by rocket exhaust pouring from above. The room begins to rumble as the ascent commences.
related_events: Austin confronts Dr. Evil with a threat
Mrs. Kensington reacts to Dr. Evil's self-freezing
Austin opens fire on the egg chair

name: Dr. Evil Escapes in Egg Chair
description: Dr. Evil climbs into an egg-shaped chair as white mist fills the chamber. Austin fires at the chair, but the ceiling opens and the egg begins to rise. Rocket exhaust blasts from above, pouring down as the structure trembles. The chair ascends through the opening, carrying Dr. Evil and the white cat. Before the doors close, the cat jumps into the chair. A sign on the egg reads 'CRYOGENIC FREEZING BEGINNING.'
related_events: Egg chair ascends through an opening in the ceiling
Rocket exhaust ignites and causes structural rumbling

name: Arrival and Unpacking in the Hotel Room
description: Vanessa and Austin enter their shared hotel room, each carrying their luggage. Vanessa reminds Austin that they are sharing the room only to maintain their cover as a married couple on vacation. Austin responds with a series of crude jokes about intimacy, asking Vanessa when they plan to have sex and making exaggerated comments about personal hygiene. Vanessa reacts with irritation, and Austin quickly backtracks, saying he was only joking and trying to get a rise out of her. They both laugh, the tension easing. Vanessa then suggests they unpack. She opens her compact flight attendant bag, revealing neatly organized items in labeled plastic bags, including her underthings, shoes, a clothes steamer, and a blow dryer. Austin pulls out a Nehru jacket, a large Remington shaver with a British plug, a vintage 1967 Playboy magazine, a bottle of Jurgens lotion, a miniature meditation gong, and a bottle of Hai Karate cologne. When he removes a Swedish penis enlarger pump, Vanessa sees it. Austin claims it must be a prank, insisting it isn’t his. Vanessa gives a skeptical, pained look. Austin then picks up the phone, dials a number, and after a moment hears a recorded male voice welcoming him to 777-FILM. He covers the mouthpiece and whispers to Vanessa that he reached an answering machine.
related_events: Vanessa and Austin arrive with their luggage for a shared hotel room
Vanessa clarifies the purpose of their room sharing
Austin jokes about intimacy to provoke Vanessa
Vanessa suggests unpacking after resolving tension

name: Unpacking in Contrast
description: Vanessa unzips her compact flight attendant bag and opens the inside flap, revealing a typed list of contents. Each of her items is sealed in its own labeled plastic bag—"Underthings," "Shoes"—alongside a compact clothes steamer, a Braun blow dryer, and Wet-Naps. She places them neatly into the drawer. Austin, standing beside his two bright red oversized leatherette Samsonite suitcases, pulls out a Nehru jacket and a large Remington shaver with a bulky English plug. He adds a vintage 1967 issue of Playboy and a bottle of Jurgens lotion to the growing pile on the bed. Vanessa retrieves a dossier marked "Dr. Evil - Top Secret" and sets it aside. Austin produces a miniature meditation gong and a bottle of Hai Karate cologne. Then, he pulls out a Swedish penis enlarger pump. Vanessa looks over, eyes widening. Austin holds it up, laughing. "Hey, who put this in here? Someone's playing a prank on me! Honestly, this isn't mine." Vanessa sighs. "I'm sure." Austin shrugs, tosses the item aside, and picks up the phone. He dials, listens for a moment, then covers the mouthpiece. "I got her answering machine," he whispers.
related_events: Vanessa observes her own meticulously organized luggage contents
Austin reveals eccentric personal items from his luggage

name: Vanessa Finds the Enlarger Pump
description: Vanessa pulls a Swedish penis enlarger pump from Austin's luggage and looks at it in disbelief. Austin sees her reaction and quickly picks up the device, holding it with an expression of surprise. He insists it isn't his, saying someone must have planted it as a joke. Vanessa stares at him, her face tense, saying nothing.
related_events: Vanessa discovers Austin's Swedish penis enlarger pump in his luggage
Austin denies ownership of the Swedish penis enlarger pump

name: Austin's Misdirected Call to Room Service
description: Austin picks up the phone and dials what he believes is room service, holding the receiver to his ear. After a moment, a loud male voice booms from the handset, greeting him with a recorded message from 777-FILM. Austin quickly covers the mouthpiece and whispers to Vanessa that he’s reached an answering machine. The call plays out as a pre-recorded, automated service, not the room service he expected.
related_events: Austin attempts to call room service using a movie phone line

name: Mick Jagger Greets Austin Powers at Press Conference
description: At a press conference held in a swinging club, Mick Jagger approaches Austin Powers and calls out to him. 'Hey Austin Powers, it's me, Mick Jagger,' he says. Austin turns and responds warmly, 'Hey, Mick!' The two exchange greetings in front of the gathered crowd and media.
related_events: Mick Jagger greets Austin Powers

name: Mick Jagger and Austin Powers Exchange at Press Conference
description: At a press conference in a swinging club, Mick Jagger approaches Austin Powers and asks if he is more satisfied sexually. Austin replies, 'Well, you can't always get what you want.' Mick pauses, struck by the phrase, and says it would make a great song title. He announces he will write it and expects it to be a hit. Austin congratulates him. A vinyl 45 of 'You Can't Always Get What You Want' appears on screen, followed by a Billboard chart showing the song at number one.
related_events: Mick Jagger asks Austin Powers about sexual satisfaction
Austin Powers quotes a lyrical idea about desire

name: Mick Jagger Hears a Line and Writes a Song
description: At a press conference in a swinging club, Mick Jagger talks with Austin Powers. After Austin says, 'You can't always get what you want,' Mick pauses, then declares that the line will be the title of a new song he plans to write, certain it will be a hit. He grins and exclaims, 'Groovy!' A short time later, a vinyl 45 of 'You Can't Always Get What You Want' appears on screen, followed by a Billboard chart showing the song at number one.
related_events: Mick Jagger decides to write a song based on the quote
Mick Jagger celebrates the idea as groovy

name: The Song Reaches Number One
description: A vinyl 45 of 'You Can't Always Get What You Want' appears on screen. Moments later, the Billboard chart is shown, with the song at number one.
related_events: Vinyl 45 of 'You Can't Always Get What You Want' appears on screen
'You Can't Always Get What You Want' reaches number one on Billboard chart

name: Austin Powers Receives a Call from British Intelligence
description: Austin Powers and Mrs. Kensington drive through a simulated 1960s London streetscape. A flashing red light appears, accompanied by a ringing sound. Mrs. Kensington notes that the call is from Basil Exposition, Chief of British Intelligence. The glove compartment of the car rotates open, revealing a picture phone. On the screen, Basil Exposition appears, seated at a desk with a nameplate that reads 'Basil Exposition, Chief of British Intelligence.' He greets Austin and confirms the year is 1967. He warns that Dr. Evil has escaped from Zedel Edel Prison in Baaden Baaden and is planning a trap at the Electric Psychedelic Pussycat Swinger's Club in Picadilly Circus. A panel in the car rotates to show a map of London, displaying their current location and the club. Austin acknowledges the information and tells Mrs. Kensington to drive to the club. Before the call ends, Basil Exposition pauses and tells Austin to be careful. Austin thanks him, and the call concludes.
related_events: Mrs. Kensington receives call from Basil Exposition via picture phone
Austin Powers greets Mrs. Kensington during drive through 1960s London
related_occasions: Confrontation Trap At Electric Psychedelic Pussycat Swinger'S Club

name: Basil Exposition Delivers Mission Briefing
description: A flashing red light activates and a distinctive phone ring sounds inside the Jaguar. The glove compartment revolves to reveal a picture phone, on which Basil Exposition appears. He greets Austin Powers and confirms that the year is 1967, that Austin is an international agent, and that he is traveling with Agent Mrs. Kensington. Basil states that Dr. Evil has escaped from Zedel Edel Prison in Baaden Baaden and is planning a trap for Austin at the Electric Psychedelic Pussycat Swinger's Club in Picadilly Circus. A panel in the car rotates to display a map of London, showing Austin's current location and the club's position. Austin acknowledges the information and tells Mrs. Kensington it is time to go.
related_events: Basil Exposition introduces himself and provides situational update
Basil Exposition reveals Dr. Evil's escape and trap plan
related_occasions: Confrontation Trap At Electric Psychedelic Pussycat Swinger'S Club

name: Austin Powers Receives Map and Heads to the Swinger's Club
description: A panel in the car rotates, revealing a map of London with lights indicating Austin Powers' current position and the location of the Electric Psychedelic Pussycat Swinger's Club in Picadilly Circus. Austin looks at the map, then turns to Mrs. Kensington and says, 'Let's go, baby!'
related_events: Map panel reveals Austin's location and target club in London
Austin Powers decides to confront Dr. Evil at the club
related_occasions: Confrontation Trap At Electric Psychedelic Pussycat Swinger'S Club

name: Basil Exposition Delivers Final Warning
description: As the call comes to an end, Basil Exposition pauses and looks directly at Austin Powers on the picture phone screen. 'Oh, and Austin—be careful,' he says. Austin nods. 'Thank you.' He turns to Mrs. Kensington and says, 'Let's go, baby!'
related_events: Basil Exposition warns Austin Powers to be careful
related_occasions: Confrontation Trap At Electric Psychedelic Pussycat Swinger'S Club

name: Detection of the Bob's Big Boy Rocket
description: At NORAD's tracking facility in Colorado Springs, a radar operator spots an unidentified blip moving erratically across the screen. He calls Commander Gilmour in his office to report a potential bogey with an unorthodox entry angle and a non-stealth, standard alloy composition. When asked if it belongs to their forces, the operator confirms it does not and adds that the object has an unusual shape—it appears to be in the form of Bob's Big Boy. Commander Gilmour reacts with shock, muttering, "Oh my God, he's back." The operator notes the object's appearance matches the long-lost Bob's Big Boy rocket, now weathered from decades in space. As the object vanishes from radar over Nevada, Gilmour orders the operator to forget what he saw and not log the event. He then makes a call to Sergeant Philips, instructing him to contact the President, prepare a jet, and pack his overnight bag. Before leaving, he reminds Philips to feed his fish—but not too much. Gilmour departs for London, England.
related_events: Radar operator detects unidentified object with unusual shape
Commander Gilmour receives report about non-standard aircraft
Radar operator identifies object as resembling Bob's Big Boy
Commander Gilmour reacts with shock to object's identity
related_occasions: Norad Monitoring Operation At Colorado Springs

name: Commander Gilmour Suppresses the Sighting Report

name: Austin Meets Vanessa Kensington
description: Austin is introduced to Vanessa Kensington, who enters the room and places a stack of files on the table. She explains that her job is to help him adjust to the 1990s, noting that a lot has changed since 1967. Austin responds by saying that as long as people are still having promiscuous sex with many anonymous partners without protection, while experimenting with mind-expanding drugs in a consequence-free environment, he will have no trouble fitting in. Vanessa replies that her mother has told her all about him. Austin says that if the stories are lies, he’ll damn her, and if they’re true, he’ll damn himself. He then asks how her mother is doing. Vanessa responds that her mother is doing quite well, thank you very much.
related_events: Austin reveals his outdated views on sex and drugs
Austin makes a self-deprecating joke about his past behavior

name: Basil's Final Words Before Departure
description: Before leaving, Basil pulls Austin aside and quietly remarks that Vanessa is a bit too dedicated, giving him a knowing look. He then steps back, offers a few parting words of encouragement, and reminds Austin to be careful. With a final nod, he exits the room, leaving Austin and Vanessa alone.
related_events: Basil Exposition privately warns Austin about Vanessa's dedication
Basil Exposition gives final encouragement and caution to Austin

name: Dr. Evil Confronts His Partially Frozen State
description: Dr. Evil addresses the group, revealing that due to a technical error, his right arm was not frozen during the reanimation process. He expresses distress, holding up his right arm and declaring himself only half a man. Mustafa insists the procedure was successful, explaining that Dr. Evil's autonomic functions were shut down and the aging of the unfrozen arm was retarded, making it only slightly older than the left. He suggests squeezing a tennis ball for twenty minutes a day to strengthen the arm. Dr. Evil dismisses the suggestion and turns his anger toward Mr. Bigglesworth, who now appears completely hairless with a fringe of white hair around his ears. Mustafa attempts to explain the unforeseen feline complications, but Dr. Evil silences him. A button is pressed, causing Mustafa's chair to tip backward into a pit. Mustafa screams, calling for help from below, claiming he is still alive and badly burned. Dr. Evil picks up a phone and murmurs into it. Mustafa pleads for someone to open the retrieval hatch, but his voice is cut off by a muffled gunshot. Another shot follows after he cries out in pain. Dr. Evil then introduces the members of his Evil Cabinet, beginning with Frau Farbissina.
related_events: Dr. Evil reveals his partially frozen state due to a technical error
Mustafa defends the success of the reanimation design
Dr. Evil expresses distress over his physical condition
Mustafa suggests physical therapy with a tennis ball to strengthen the arm

name: Dr. Evil Confronts Mustafa About Mr. Bigglesworth's Condition
description: Dr. Evil turns his attention to Mr. Bigglesworth, who stands revealed as completely hairless, with only a thin fringe of white hair around his ears. He demands to know what happened to his cat. Mustafa responds that they could not anticipate the feline complications arising from the reanimation process. Dr. Evil, his face unseen, cuts him off with a sharp command for silence.
related_events: Dr. Evil confronts Mustafa about Mr. Bigglesworth's appearance
Mustafa explains unforeseen feline complications in reanimation

name: Dr. Evil Executes Mustafa During Cabinet Meeting
description: Dr. Evil pressed a button, causing Mustafa's chair to tip backward and drop him into a pit. Mustafa screamed in terror as he fell. From below, he called out for help, pleading to be rescued and asking for an ambulance. Dr. Evil paused briefly to take a phone call, then ignored the continued cries. Mustafa shouted up from the pit, explaining he was badly burned and could be retrieved using a hatch. Dr. Evil picked up a gun and fired a muffled shot. Mustafa cried out, wounded in the arm. Another shot followed. The pit fell silent. Dr. Evil then introduced the members of his Evil Cabinet, beginning with Frau Farbissina.
related_events: Dr. Evil silences Mustafa and activates a trap mechanism
Mustafa falls into a pit and screams in terror
Dr. Evil issues a warning against failure to his organization
Mustafa pleads for rescue and medical assistance from the pit
Dr. Evil shoots Mustafa in the pit to silence him

name: Dr. Evil Forms His Evil Cabinet
description: Dr. Evil announces the formation of his Evil Cabinet, addressing the group with a mix of authority and distraction. He pauses momentarily to take a private call on a white phone, speaking in low murmurs. After hanging up, he begins introducing the members of his inner circle. First, he calls out Frau Farbissina, acknowledging her role as founder of the militant wing of the Salvation Army. Next is Random Task, a large Korean man in a butler's uniform, whom Dr. Evil identifies as an ex-wrestler and evil handyman extraordinaire. To demonstrate his skills, Random Task stands, bows, removes his shoe, and hurls it across the room, striking the head off a sculpture. Dr. Evil thanks him and moves on, introducing Patty O'Brien, a small, wiry Irishman with fiery eyes, once an Irish assassin known for a deadly trademark.
related_events: Dr. Evil introduces the formation of his Evil Cabinet
Dr. Evil makes a phone call while addressing the group
Dr. Evil begins introducing members of his Evil Cabinet

name: Random Task Demonstrates His Skill
description: During the gathering of the Evil Cabinet, Dr. Evil introduces Random Task, a large Korean man in a butler's uniform. At Dr. Evil's request, Random Task stands, bows, then removes one of his shoes and hurls it across the room. The shoe strikes a sculpture on the far side, knocking its head off cleanly. He returns to his seat without comment.
related_events: Random Task demonstrates his throwing ability by destroying a sculpture

name: Patty O'Brien's Lucky Charms Joke at the Evil Cabinet Meeting
description: During the Evil Cabinet formation meeting, Patty O'Brien jokes that Scotland Yard is after his lucky charms. The room erupts in laughter. Confused, Patty looks around as Frau Farbissina steps in and explains that 'Lucky Charms' is the name of a well-known cereal, famous for its commercials featuring leprechauns and colorful marshmallows. Patty nods in understanding as the others continue to chuckle, the joke now landing with its full effect.
related_events: Patty O'Brien makes joke about police pursuing her lucky charms
Frau Farbissina explains Lucky Charms cereal commercial to Patty O'Brien

name: Number Two Presents Virtucon's Empire
description: Dr. Evil introduces Number Two as his second-in-command. The conference table rotates to reveal an illuminated map of the United States. Number Two steps forward and begins detailing Virtucon's transformation, explaining its shift from a chemical company to a major player in the communications industry. He lists the organization's extensive holdings across the U.S., including cable companies, a steel mill, shipping operations, oil refineries, and a miniature model factory. To illustrate further, he holds up a collector's plate from the Franklin Mint, displaying it as part of the company's portfolio.
related_events: Dr. Evil introduces Number Two as his second-in-command
Conference table rotates to reveal illuminated map of the United States
Number Two demonstrates Virtucon's expansion into the communication industry
Number Two reveals Virtucon's industrial holdings
Number Two displays Franklin Mint collector's plate

name: Dr. Evil's Outdated Blackmail Plans
description: Dr. Evil stands before his newly assembled Evil Cabinet and presents his first blackmail scheme: exposing an affair involving Prince Charles. Number Two interrupts to inform him that the affair has already been made public. Unfazed, Dr. Evil proposes a second plan—using a weather machine to damage the ozone layer, holding the world hostage. Again, Number Two points out that significant ozone layer damage has already occurred and is widely known. The room remains silent as Dr. Evil processes the news, his plans rendered useless by the passage of time.
related_events: Dr. Evil proposes blackmail scheme involving Prince Charles' affair
Number Two informs Dr. Evil that Prince Charles' affair is already public
Dr. Evil proposes using weather machine to damage ozone layer

name: Dr. Evil Sets Nuclear Ransom Demand During Cabinet Meeting
description: Dr. Evil addresses the Evil Cabinet and announces his plan to steal a nuclear warhead that Kreplachistan is transferring to the United Nations. He declares his intention to hold the world ransom for one million dollars. Number Two hesitates, questioning the amount as too low given Virtucon's financial resources. He reminds Dr. Evil that Virtucon's annual revenue exceeds nine billion dollars. In response, Dr. Evil raises the demand to five million dollars. After a pause, and with renewed determination, he abruptly increases the ransom to one hundred billion dollars. The room falls silent as Dr. Evil finalizes the extortion plan, adjusting his strategy based on the updated financial information.
related_events: Dr. Evil announces plan to steal nuclear warhead and ransom the world
Dr. Evil increases ransom demand to five million dollars
Number Two points out Virtucon's annual revenue exceeds nine billion dollars
Dr. Evil sets final ransom demand at one hundred billion dollars
Number Two questions ransom amount of one million dollars

name: Scott Evil Meets His Father
description: Frau Farbissina announces that during Dr. Evil's absence, his frozen semen was used to create a son. A teenage boy enters the room—Scott Evil, now fifteen. He stands silently as Dr. Evil processes the revelation. Dr. Evil's expression shifts from shock to deep emotion, his voice trembling as he looks at his son. He speaks of legacy and tells Scott that one day, the entire criminal empire will be his. Scott stares at him coldly, his arms crossed. Without a word, he turns and walks out of the room. Dr. Evil remains seated, watching the door close behind him.
related_events: Frau Farbissina reveals that Dr. Evil's frozen semen was used to create a son
Scott Evil meets Dr. Evil for the first time
Dr. Evil expresses emotional joy at discovering he has a son
Dr. Evil promises Scott control over his criminal empire
Scott Evil rejects Dr. Evil's attempt at reconciliation

name: Dr. Evil Announces Nuclear Warhead Hijacking
description: Dr. Evil stands before his newly assembled team, his bald head gleaming under the dim light. He declares his intention to intercept a nuclear warhead currently in transit from Kreplachistan to the United Nations. The device will be seized and used to demand a massive ransom from the world. He outlines the operation with cold precision, his voice steady despite the muffled cries still echoing from below. The room remains silent as he finishes, the weight of the plan settling over the group. Outside, the faint sound of machinery hums in the distance.
related_events: Dr. Evil decides to hijack nuclear weapons to hold world hostage
Dr. Evil announces plan to steal nuclear warhead and ransom the world
